Container.Name: Yharnam-Together-Server
Container.Overview: Yharnam Together dedicated server. Choose an image tag matching every client release. Host network requires UDP 31314 and TCP 31315 and 20443. Data directory must be writable by UID and GID 10001; back up the entire directory including link_key.bin. See the README before installing or updating.

Config.Name: Server data
Config.Description: Worlds, databases, settings and server key. Must be writable by UID:GID 10001:10001.
